title: generate.failed
description: The generation failed; code names why (closed), and a refused call carries its rejection.

rejection.description: Why a not-json or schema-mismatch call was refused, as the original's selection rejection: key a stable string (not-json, schema-mismatch:name, or schema-mismatch:<JSON pointer of where the arguments first fail>), message a one-line diagnostic that repeats no argument value; each at most 200 characters.
